title: Dumpling Soup
description: A comforting and easy-to-make soup filled with nutty dumplings.
instructions: In a large pot, combine vegetable broth and raw carrots. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour and whole wheat flour.
Gradually add the dry mixture to the pot, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Add dumplings to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Season with friendly herbs and serve hot.
